mapper.select:
select `cci`.id as `couponId`, `cci`.name as `couponName`, `cci`.`type` as `couponType`, concat_ws(' - ', date_format(`cci`.`available_sale_start_date`, '%Y/%m/%d'), date_format(`cci`.`available_sale_end_date`, '%Y/%m/%d')) as `saleSegment`, `cci`.`sold_amount` as `soldAmount`, sum(`ca`.`allocate_num`) as `allocateNum`, (select sum(`c`.`status` in (1, 2)) from `card` `c` where `c`.`coupon_id` = `ca`.`coupon_id` and `c`.`org_id` = `ca`.`org_id` group by `c`.`coupon_id`, `c`.`org_id`) as `soldNum`, `ca`.`org_id` as `orgId` from `coupon_common_info` `cci` inner join `coupon_allocate` `ca` on `cci`.`id` = `ca`.`coupon_id` where `ca`.`org_id` = #{orgId} and isnull(`ca`.`allocate_user_id`) = 0 and isnull(`ca`.`allocate_date`) = 0
and `cci`.`name` like concat('%', #{couponName}, '%')
and `cci`.`type` in
#{item}
group by `ca`.`coupon_id`, `ca`.`org_id`

select `c`.`id`, `c`.`card_number`, `c`.`sold_target`, `c`.`sold_phone_number`, case when `c`.`is_sold_and_pay` = 1 then `cci`.`sold_amount` else 0 end as `paidAmount`, case when `c`.`is_sold_and_pay` = 0 then 1 else 0 end as `charge`, case when `c`.`is_sold_and_pay` = 0 then `cci`.`sold_amount` else 0 end as `soldAmount` from `card` `c` inner join `coupon_common_info` `cci` on `c`.`coupon_id` = `cci`.`id` where `c`.`card_number` = #{cardNumber} and `c`.`card_password` = #{cardPassword}
